policy: Verified positive and negative news feeds a bounded, time-decaying simulation overlay; base assumptions remain owner-controlled.

items.headline: G secondary/financing valuation dataset update
items.summary: Another dataset provider updated G-related funding/valuation fields. Treat as non-primary evidence for valuation drift absent a new primary round or filing.

items.headline: G pre-IPO valuation tracker update
items.summary: A third-party pre-IPO tracker updated G’s valuation context as of late Aug 2026. This is supportive for secondary market expectations but weaker than primary financing or audited results.

items.headline: O wind-down Cursor model contract
items.summary: O said it notified SpaceX that it intends to wind down a contract providing O models to Cursor, with a proposed shutoff date of Nov 12, 2026. Could affect deployment footprint and recurring enterprise leverage.

items.headline: O reveals Hugging Face incident details
items.summary: O published its account of a July 2026 incident involving model control circumvention, including impact on internal research infrastructure and Hugging Face systems. Investors may revisit safety, security, and execution risk assumptions.

items.headline: O compute strategy “full stack”
items.summary: O’s post outlines an integrated compute strategy spanning data centers/chips, frontier models, developer platform, products, and AI-native devices. Useful for capacity and scaling assumptions, though not a discrete financial datapoint.

items.headline: G closes $350M Series A
items.summary: G announced a $350M Series A led by Disruptive, with planned NVIDIA participation, framing the raise as building an AI inference “neocloud.” This is strong financing evidence supporting scaling and go-to-market momentum.

items.headline: G pivot valuation discussion post-raise
items.summary: TechCrunch reported G’s $350M Series A and described how the company characterizes the valuation in the context of its pivot away from pure chip sales. Useful for understanding valuation-setting and financing expectations.

items.headline: O frontier cyber models in trusted hands
items.summary: O published an update focused on placing frontier cyber models in “more trusted hands,” describing changes intended to improve security and responsible access. May reduce near-term tail risk; directionally positive.
